{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows
display(sales.head())

# Check column names
print("Columns:", sales.columns.tolist())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:\n", sales.isnull().sum())

# Check data types
display(sales.dtypes)

# Check unique values in loyalty_status
print("Unique values in 'loyalty_status':", sales['loyalty_status'].unique())

# Check unique values in 'status'
print("Unique values in 'status':", sales['status'].unique())

# Check if 'revenue' is numeric
print("Is 'revenue' numeric?", pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(sales['revenue']))"}
